demos.name: Privilege Model Armor LAB
demos.description: One external inspector per LLM key (Model Armor, with Azure and Bedrock stubs) and the authority cap: the same finding blocks when enforcing and is only logged when advisory. Fail open or closed, a timeout, a named error. Mock only; the rest is UNVERIFIED lab model.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7839, PROVISIONAL and not claimed on the board). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials; Real is not built (the toggle is disabled with the reason). Docker: HOST_PORT=7839 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). catalogId D000 is a placeholder: the owner assigns the real catalog id and the port before the registry entry is made. Repo: curtismu7/privilege-model-armor-LAB. Fork of ai-guard-sidecar-LAB.
